assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
The claim/denial pertains to episode ep-05192.
The clinical indication note states the patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks.
The clinical indication note states the patient has a history of cerebral infarction.
The note states the patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia.
The submitted diagnosis codes are G45.9 and Z86.73.

The note states mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms.
The appellant requests review and reprocessing of the claim.
